notes.title: Developer's Notes (8/18/2023)
notes.content:
The following changes were made as of the most recent update:

[list]
[*]Fixed the lack of footstep sounds when Hannah is dancing during the scene with the council of cats.
[*]Fixed the issue where Goober's dialogue remains on the screen after the end of the scene where you must clear garbage bags from the street.
[*]Changed the text from “Back to the Main Menu” in the in-game key bindings menu to “Back”.
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

Dancing Mango Games

notes.title: Developer's Notes (8/11/2023)
notes.content:
The following changes were made as of the most recent update:

[list]
[*]Fixed an error where the sound settings set in the main menu did not seem to apply after loading into a new game until “Apply Settings” was clicked in the pause menu. 
[*]Fixed an error where the crouch button did not work until after visiting the key bindings menu.
[*]Fixed an error where rebinding the crouch button did not unbind it from the previous binding, allowing both the old and new binding to trigger the crouch action.
[*]Fixed an error where two scenes in the “practice spells” quest were sometimes triggering at the same time, leading to errors in the UI and quest completion tracking. 
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

Dancing Mango Games

notes.title: Developer's Notes (8/4/2023)
notes.content:
The following changes were made as of the most recent update:

[list]
[*]Added an option to reset key bindings to their default values.
[*]Added an option to bind mouse buttons to bindable actions.
[*]Added the ability to navigate the menus with the mouse scroll wheel.
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

Dancing Mango Games

notes.title: Developer's Weekly Notes (7/28/2023)
notes.content:
The following changes were made as of the most recent update:

[list]
[*] Fixed/expanded the crouch action rebinding in the settings menu.
[*] Removed the unexpected scene that sometimes played during loading after pressing “continue” in the main menu.
[*] Goober now remarks when you unfocus the game window during the performance of a spell, if the game is not paused.
[*] The warning about unsaved data now appears when the “Exit to Main Menu” button is highlighted via keyboard and gamepad controller.
[*] Fixed issue where Goober is sometimes partially submerged in the sidewalk.
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

Dancing Mango Games
